title: URL to Video: Product Link to Video Ad | AIVideosUGC
description: URL to video for online stores: paste a product page link and get a short vertical video ad. We pull the photo and product name, you check them and press go.
h1: URL to Video: Turn a Product Link into a Video Ad
lead: URL to video starts with the link to your product page. We pull the main product photo and the product name, you check them, and we turn them into a short video ad.
secondary_keywords: turn a link into a video
intro: Most stores already have everything a short ad needs on the product page: a clean photo and a clear product name. URL to Video saves you the step of downloading the photo and typing out a description. Paste the link, and the photo and name appear in the workspace, ready for you to check.

After the image and name appear, check them, choose 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4, add a sentence about the scene, and select 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. You can replace the image or edit the description before generation.

benefits.d: The product photo and name come straight from your product page.
Check the photo and edit the description before you generate.
Use the link to any public product page you own or sell on.

steps.d: Copy the address of a product page and paste it into the link box.
We fill in the main product photo and the product name. Swap the photo or edit the text if you like.
Choose 9:16, 1:1 or 16:9 and 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, then download your video.

uses.d: Turn a fresh product page into a first ad the same day it goes live.
Make a short clip for products that only have still photos today.
Paste the same link again with a different description to try another angle.

faq.a: Most public product pages work, including many Shopify and WooCommerce stores. If a page is private, needs a login or blocks automated visits, upload the product photo instead.

faq.q: What do you take from the page?
faq.a: Only the main product photo and the product name. Prices, reviews and other text on the page are not used.

faq.q: Can I use a link to someone else's product?
faq.a: Only use links to products you own or are allowed to advertise, and only photos you have the rights to use.

faq.q: Can I change the photo you picked?
faq.a: Yes. If the photo isn't the best one, replace it with your own upload before you generate.

overview.h2: Turn an existing product page into a checked starting point
overview.p: URL to Video removes two small chores: downloading the main product image and retyping its name. Paste a public product-page link, inspect what appears in the workspace, then decide what the clip should show before any credits are used.

overview.h2: The link starts the job; your review finishes it
overview.p: The importer supplies a product image and title when the page exposes usable product data. It does not replace your judgment about the scene, the product variant, or the final wording, so review each field and swap the image whenever the picked frame is not the right one.

input_guide.h2: Use a product page that can be checked

items.d: Use a product page you own or are allowed to advertise, without a login wall or private workspace requirement.

items.t: Give the page one clear hero image
items.d: A main product photo with the item visible on its own gives the importer a stronger starting frame.
Confirm that the imported name matches the product variant you want to show before you write the scene.
If the page chooses a lifestyle crop, a swatch, or the wrong variant, upload the product photo you actually want to animate.
The link supplies a reference; your sentence still needs to say what happens, where it happens, and how the product enters the frame.

items.t: A product reference from the page
items.d: The importer brings in the main image and product name when the public page exposes usable product information.
Edit the imported text, replace the image, choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds, and select 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4.

items.t: A cost you can check first
items.d: The workspace shows the credit amount before the run, and failed jobs return their reserved credits.
The download carries no watermark and can be used commercially after you verify that the item, variant, and final claims are accurate.

scene_recipes.h2: Scenes to write after the link imports

items.d: A newly listed ceramic mug sits on a breakfast table while a hand lifts it toward the morning window.
A product page image of a desk lamp becomes a close scene of the switch turning on beside a notebook.
The imported water bottle is pulled from a gym bag and placed beside a towel on a bench.
The imported candle appears in a kraft box as tissue folds back on a pale packing table.
The product is shown from the side while a hand opens the lid and points to the inner compartment.

after_download.h2: Review the imported product before publishing

items.d: Compare the clip with the product page and check color, size, included pieces, and packaging before using it in an ad.
Type the current price, date, discount, captions, and music in your editing or publishing tool.

items.t: Keep the source link with the file
items.d: Store the page URL and the selected image alongside the download so your team can trace which product reference the scene used.

fit.h2: When URL to Video saves the most setup
good: Catalogs with public product pages and a strong main image
Launch teams that need a first visual when a listing goes live
Stores refreshing still-only pages with one additional moving asset
Sellers testing several scenes from one approved product reference
not_ideal: Private pages that require a login or block public retrieval
Listings where the hero image does not show the product variant clearly
